column1: # Drone telemetry label under the aircraft on the map (Ken, Nov 23: ATO/AGL jittered as digits came and went).
# Shared by Android FixedWidthStatusLabelTest and iOS FixedWidthStatusLabelTests. _ = U+2007 FIGURE SPACE.
# Numeric values right-aligned in 3-character slots (sign included): ATO, AGL, AOL, HDG, TRK, CAM; longer
# values just take more room. RNG goes last, unpadded (it often runs past 999). Status tokens unchanged;
# a unit token stays with its value.
ATO:4 m AGL:12 m AOL:-- RNG:350 m HDG:90°
column2: ATO:__4 m AGL:_12 m AOL:-- HDG:_90° RNG:350 m
